Paused continuation and project viability reassessment

requirements.title: Conformance to Current Scripted Shot Direction
requirements.definition: Scene content and shot direction must follow the current client-approved script and explicit client clarifications when the script differs from an older storyboard reel.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers which approved direction governs rendering, not the concrete composition of each independently specified shot or the workflow for requesting clarification.

requirements.title: Text Cards Excluded from Freelancer Deliverable
requirements.definition: The freelancer is not responsible for creating the trailer's text cards because the client will create them.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an explicit deliverable-scope exclusion rather than a general trailer-content Requirement.

requirements.title: Character Artistic Style Fidelity
requirements.definition: Character renders for Q, Deadwax, and Nova must preserve the intended detailed, rough, dark, sketch-like graffiti aesthetic without drifting toward a clean, simple, or polished look.
requirements.boundary_note: The three characters remain attributes of one coordinated style mechanism because the client repeatedly requests a shared style pass across all three; background quality, set continuity, and character shadows are independently testable Requirements.

requirements.title: Full-Color Final Video
requirements.definition: The final trailer must be delivered in full color rather than in the black-and-white style used for economical storyboard preparation.
requirements.boundary_note: Color treatment can change independently of aspect ratio, animation medium, and scene composition.

requirements.title: Vertical 9:16 Video Format
requirements.definition: The final trailer must use a vertical 9:16 aspect ratio.
requirements.boundary_note: Aspect ratio is an independently enforceable output constraint rather than an attribute of color or animation style.

requirements.title: Background and Set Image Quality
requirements.definition: Background and set images must have sufficient visual quality and resolution, using regenerated backgrounds or adjusted shot angles when needed.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers background resolution and usable image quality; stylistic continuity, visual distinction between sets, and exact shot framing can succeed or fail independently.

requirements.title: Opening Aerial Establishing Shot
requirements.definition: The trailer should include the requested opening aerial establishing shot, subject to its explicitly lower production priority.
requirements.boundary_note: The aerial establishing shot is separate from the subsequent paired wide, medium, and closer character-shot sequence and can be deferred independently.

requirements.title: CC1 Q and Deadwax Framing Sequence
requirements.definition: The relevant CC1 sequence must preserve three paired Q and Deadwax compositions progressing from long or wide shots to medium shots and then closer waist-up shots.
requirements.boundary_note: The paired framing progression is one tightly coupled sequence; the opening aerial shot, Q-specific cropping, and background-object placement remain independently changeable.

requirements.title: Background Style Continuity Across Shots
requirements.definition: New or revised sets and backgrounds must remain stylistically on point and visually consistent across related shots.
requirements.boundary_note: Continuity measures whether related backgrounds share a coherent style; it is independent from resolution quality and from whether separate sets are sufficiently distinguishable.

requirements.title: Visual Distinction Between Sets
requirements.definition: Different story sets must retain sufficient visual distinction rather than becoming more similar than intended during image revision.
requirements.boundary_note: Set distinction can fail even when all backgrounds are high resolution and stylistically coherent, so it is separate from quality and continuity.

requirements.title: Q Image Cropping
requirements.definition: Q's source images must use the client-requested crop and composition while preserving the approved character and background details.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently revised crop of Q images; background bridge removal and restoration of character shadows are separate visual corrections.

requirements.title: Q Background Bridge Composition
requirements.definition: Q images must remove the lower bridge behind his waist and the bridge immediately above his head while retaining the upper bridge.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a concrete shot-local object-placement constraint that can be changed and verified independently of cropping, shadows, and general background quality.

requirements.title: Character Shadows in Rendered Images
requirements.definition: Rendered character images must include the character shadows present in earlier renders while preserving the other approved image details.
requirements.boundary_note: Shadow presence has its own observable failure and correction path and is not merely a synonym for overall artistic style.

requirements.title: Clarification Before Generating Deviating Shots
requirements.definition: For shots that differ from the storyboard reel, the freelancer should use the client's detailed descriptions and request necessary clarification before generating frames.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a task-local production obligation intended to prevent incorrect generation, distinct from the substantive Requirement that rendered shots conform to approved direction.

requirements.title: Animated Output with Still-Frame Fallback
requirements.definition: The primary deliverable approach is animation, with a digital comic using still frames as a fallback only if animation quality is inadequate or animation proves too difficult or expensive.
requirements.boundary_note: Animation tests and look-development attempts are evidence used to evaluate this output choice, not separate generic testing Requirements.
